findings.description: At 00:00–00:10 the truck has a pale aerodynamic cab with a tall rounded sleeper and small upper side window. At 01:41 the truck approached by the departing man has a dark green short conventional cab, no tall sleeper, a squared hood and a striped rectangular cargo box. The missing sleeper and different cab/hood construction cannot be explained by dawn lighting or the changed camera angle. Although daylight advances during the diner visit, no vehicle exchange or replacement arrival is established.
